relations.statement: Recovery criterion for error set E holds iff for all e1,e2 in E, e1+e2 (as a Pauli/binary error) lies outside (ker Q minus B), i.e. is not a nontrivial logical (Knill-Laflamme correspondence cited, not derived).
relations.hypotheses: Knill-Laflamme conditions P Ea^dagger Eb P = c_ab P; stabilizer/CSS-type setting where ker Q is the normalizer-like set and B the trivial (stabilizer) set; E closed under the weight function wt.
wt is Hamming/support weight over the same coordinate set.

relations.statement: If z has wt(z)=d and d <= 2t then z = e1+e2 with wt(e1),wt(e2) <= t (split support into two parts of sizes ceil(d/2), floor(d/2)).
relations.hypotheses: d <= 2t; supports of e1,e2 disjoint and partition supp(z); ceil(d/2) <= t.

lemmas.statement: If 2t < d then E_t satisfies the recovery criterion: for e1,e2 in E_t, wt(e1+e2) <= 2t < d so e1+e2 is not in ker Q minus B.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem sufficiency (t d : Nat) (h : 2*t < d) : True := by sorry

lemmas.statement: If d <= 2t then E_t fails the recovery criterion: take z in ker Q minus B of weight d, split it as e1+e2 with weights <= t, so e1+e2 is a nontrivial logical.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem necessity (t d : Nat) (h : d <= 2*t) : True := by sorry

lemmas.statement: E_t satisfies the recovery criterion iff 2t < d (combine L1 and the contrapositive of L2).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem main (t d : Nat) : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: E_t satisfies recovery iff t < d (single-error weight bound).
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Sum of two weight-t errors has weight up to 2t, so a weight-d logical with t < d <= 2t splits into two weight-<=t errors and breaks the criterion.
When d=2t, a weight-d logical splits into two weight-t halves, so the criterion fails; strict inequality is required.
